text: Yes, this asset experienced deforestation. In 2021, 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the asset) of tree-cover loss was observed, primarily in planted forests (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). The loss was confirmed by the JRC 2020 reference data, which mapped 98% of the area as forest. While 37.3 ha of loss occurred in small patches under 0.5 ha (not counted as an event), the remaining area meets the criteria for deforestation. No native forest loss was detected.
